messages:
Maya K: hey — first week question: who owns the different access/ownerships so i know who to ping? specifically: staging k8s, service DNS entries, alerting rules, and perms for the deploy pipeline.

Jordan L: welcome! quick map: eng-infra owns staging clusters & k8s infra, eng-platform owns CI/deploy pipeline, eng-sre owns alerts & oncall routing, and eng-security handles IAM/KMS stuff. pinging short list below. :wave:

Jordan L: @Ravi P for staging k8s (infra). @Alex T for deploy pipeline and A/B rollout configs (platform). For alert rules and runbook questions reach out to #eng-oncall or the oncall rotation.

Ravi P: hi Maya — i can add you to the staging cluster RBAC. i need your kubectl username (usually your github handle). i can also share the minimal role we use for devs.

Maya K: thanks! my github handle is mayak. what do i need to do to request DNS changes for a feature branch?

Alex T: for short-lived feature branches we use the internal proxy with branch subdomains. if you need a permanent DNS entry, file a ticket in the infra queue with this template:
```
Title: DNS request — <name> for <service>
Fields: desired hostname, target ip/loadbalancer, TTL, justification, owner
```
We usually triage within 1 business day. cc @eng-infra if it's urgent.

Maya K: great — also wondering about escalation path if something breaks after a deploy at 10pm. who gets paged?

Jordan L: post-deploy, alerts route to the oncall in eng-sre. if the alert is infra-level it goes to infra oncall; service-level goes to the owning service's oncall. If it's paging and no ack in 5m it escalates to the SRE lead and then to the oncall manager. For incident comms, #incidents channel is the place.

onboard-bot: :robot_face: Pro tip — onboarding checklist link: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/checklist (contains reqs for k8s access, GH org invite, and deploy perms). Use `onboard-bot request-access staging` to auto-open infra ticket.

Maya K: perfect — that checklist + names is exactly what i needed. thanks all! :heart:

Ravi P: i'll open the RBAC change now and ping you when it's done.

Alex T: added the ticket template link to the new-hire doc for future hires.

Jordan L: awesome. feel free to DM any time.
